note: Adapted from the original English description of Emerson 1925. The original reads Kalotermes (Glyptotermes) hospitalis, sp. nov.; type locality Kartabo, British Guiana; the description is based on 1 dewinged adult (queen) from one nest and 15 soldiers from two nests. The author states that its assignment to the subgenus Glyptotermes is provisional, as no alate specimens were seen. The worker is not described.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head length 3.24—3.25 mm, head width 1.53 mm, the frons inclined forwards about 45° and slightly lobed; left mandible with 3 small teeth, right mandible with 2. Compared with K. (Neotermes?) latifrons Silvestri the head is shorter and wider (the original describes that species as having a short, wide head). Alate (queen) head length 1.46 mm, head width 1.35 mm, pronotal width 1.18 mm, the brown wing scales contrasting with the pale yellow pronotum.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head yellow, with numerous setae, broadly oval. Antennae (broken in the specimen); segment 3 slightly larger than segment 4, segment 2 about as long as segment 3. Compound eyes medium-sized, the distance from their lower margin to the lower margin of the head about 4/6 of a compound eye diameter. Ocelli medium-sized, close to the compound eyes. Pronotum yellow, with numerous setae, slightly narrower than the head, the sides slightly narrowing posteriorly, the posterior margin not concave. Wing scales brown, contrasting slightly with the pronotum. Abdominal tergites yellow, with numerous setae. Measurements (mm): head length 1.46, head width 1.35, compound eye diameter 0.31, pronotal length 0.65, pronotal width 1.18; queen body length 6.47.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, becoming darker anteriorly; with numerous setae; head long, the sides straight and parallel; the frons inclined forwards about 45°, slightly lobed. Antennae paler than the head, 11—12-segmented, in a few 13-segmented; with 12 segments segment 3 distinctly shorter than segment 2 or 4, with 11 segments segments 3 and 4 about equal. Compound eyes unpigmented, oval and small, about one compound eye length from the base of the antennae. Mandibles black, left mandible with 3 small teeth, right mandible with 2 small teeth. Pronotum nearly concolorous with the head, with numerous setae, the sides nearly straight, the posterior margin nearly straight. Abdominal tergites with numerous setae. Measurements (mm): total body length 5.88—9.00, head length 3.24—3.25, head width 1.53, antennal length 1.47—1.59, pronotal length 0.65, pronotal width 1.29—1.47, hind tibia length 1.12—1.18, left mandible length 1.24.
